description: This file defines the 'Location' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing location data such as name, country, city, address, etc., using Doctrine ORM mappings for database integration.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Entity class representing a location with properties for name, country, city, address, contact details, and associated employees. Uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the location.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the location.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the location.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the location.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country associated with the location.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country associated with the location.

methods.name: getProvince
methods.description: Returns the province of the location.

methods.name: setProvince
methods.description: Sets the province of the location.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city of the location.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the city of the location.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address of the location.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the address of the location.

methods.name: getZipCode
methods.description: Returns the ZIP code of the location.

methods.name: setZipCode
methods.description: Sets the ZIP code of the location.

methods.name: getPhone
methods.description: Returns the phone number of the location.

methods.name: setPhone
methods.description: Sets the phone number of the location.

methods.name: getFax
methods.description: Returns the fax number of the location.

methods.name: setFax
methods.description: Sets the fax number of the location.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any notes related to the location.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets notes related to the location.
